'''Tirello Anjiliac''' was the older cousin of [[Zietta Anjiliac]], and ran the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] criminal operations of [[Point Nadir]]. He greatly disliked Zietta, and did his best to demean her by just assigning her menial tasks. Anjiliac was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Sable Dawn]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] due to a conspiracy between Zietta and [[Tis Dolan]].
